name: Shakey Lakes Park
evidence: Operator per-site booking pages (menomineecountyparks.com site__N, read 2026-10-26): Water Frontage Yes on transient RV sites 59, 65, 66, 69-75 (electric, 25-50 ft) and P3/P4/P7-P10 (31-50 ft); park map puts them on Resort/East Lake. Esri z18-19: peninsula-tip loop ~10-15 m from the west shore past sparse brush; shore-row pads ~20-25 m, boats beached at gaps.

name: Shoepac Lake State Forest Campground
evidence: Esri at 45.2402,-84.1715 (0.19-0.27 m/px, leaf-off winter frame): the loop's pads (snow patches) sit in pine forest ~80-130 m south of Shoepac Lake under continuous canopy. Carry-in launch is 200 yd past the entrance (DNR page). DNR 'located on Shoepac Lake' is prose; no per-site map.

name: Shupac Lake State Forest Campground
evidence: Esri z19 (0.21 m/px) at 44.8250,-84.4786 and z18 frames: sand pad spurs east of the campground road sit ~25-40 m from Shupac Lake through continuous hardwood/pine canopy. No DNR per-site map; 'along the shore' is prose, so no on-water proof. Kept lakeview.

name: Silver Creek State Forest Campground
evidence: Esri z18-19 with 20 OSM camp_pitch nodes plotted: nearest drive-in pads ~20-30 m from the Pine River behind a riparian tree band. The river-side sites are DNR's walk-in 20-26 on the peninsula off the parking lot, which don't count. No per-site map; kept riverview.

name: Ski-Kwe zaag'igan Lake State Forest Campground
evidence: OSM campground way 1053136798 + 13 camp_pitch nodes on Esri (0.27 m/px): pads in hardwood clearings at 46.2898-46.2911,-88.0630/-88.0646. Our pin was ~110 m N in the woods, so moved to the pitch cluster. Nearest pads (trailer at one) ~38-47 m from the bay through dense canopy. No per-site map; kept lakeview.

name: South Gemini Lake State Forest Campground
evidence: Esri z19 + Wayback 2018-2026 (all leaf-on pine): pad spurs off the loop sit ~20-30 m from Gemini Lake's south shore under canopy. The easternmost clearing (46.4817,-86.3036) is ~15 m away behind a tree fringe, but it isn't resolvable as an RV pad vs the carry-in. No per-site map; kept lakeview.

name: South Manistique Lake State Forest Campground
evidence: Esri z19 leaf-off (0.21 m/px, blurred): the campground road runs ~40-50 m inside the west shore and pads between it and the lake aren't resolvable under the trees. DNR says 'some sites have direct water access via a narrow footpath', which means set back. No per-site map; kept lakeview.

name: Sunrise Lake State Forest Campground
evidence: Esri at 44.0258,-85.3317 + OSM way 1037847164 (44.0254-44.0265): the loop is in continuous forest ~100 m south of 15/17 Mile Road, and the lake is beyond the road. DNR: the boat launch is across the road and the site is a 'forested bluff overlooking' (prose). Road plus bluff → not waterfront.
